query: WITH monthly AS (SELECT "Artist" AS artist, DATE_TRUNC('month',"Concert Date") AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT "ConcertID") AS concerts FROM "Extract"."Extract" GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT artist, MAX(month), SUM(concerts) FROM monthly GROUP BY artist ORDER BY artist
scope: Actual independent Hyper monthly aggregation; proves data endpoint expected values, not rendered visibility or browser hover actions
